tasks.title: Synchronize spectral filters with channel fluorophores
tasks.scope: Use the spectrum-derived filter suggestion whenever a structured channel has no saved complete filter pair. On a discrete library fluorophore change, clear the prior channel filter pair so the new fluorophore's default replaces it. Do not change free-text marker behavior or overwrite a filter while its user is typing.
tasks.verification: Exercise the producer-to-consumer path: a known structured channel with null stored filters must yield a plotted default filter; then change its library fluorophore after a complete old filter pair exists and prove the plotted center changes to the new emission-derived default. Preserve explicit custom-name typing behavior without a structural rerender. Run the full JS suite and the built artifact checks.
